title: Foreman: role permissions match the expected set
preconds: 1. A user is assigned the Foreman role.
steps:
1. Open the Foreman role's Permission Summary (eye icon on the Roles list).
  2. Check the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Work orders sub-settings, the View mode and the Cross-Cutting Toggles.
  3. Optionally log in as the user and spot-check a few of the role's typical tasks.
expected: The Foreman permissions match the expected set: Work orders View/Create & Edit (no Delete); Work order lines Create & Edit/Delete; Schedule full; Customers View/Create & Edit (no Delete); Part sales View only; Catalog and Inventory View/Create & Edit; Vendor and order management View/Create & Edit; Invoicing & payments View/Create & Edit (no Delete); Reports off; Customer portal off; See Financial Data on; View and Manage AP/AR Data off; View mode Full View.
